items.source:
This exception hierarchy aims to let user code find and handle the
kind of error encountered without knowing the details of the particular
data access API in use (for example, JDBC). Thus, it is possible to react to an
optimistic locking failure without knowing that JDBC is being used.
items.translation: 此异常层次结构旨在使用户代码能够查找并处理遇到的错误类型，而无需了解所用特定数据访问 API（例如 JDBC）的详细信息。因此，可以在不知道正在使用 JDBC 的情况下对乐观锁失败做出反应。

items.source:
As this class is a runtime exception, there is no need for user code
to catch it or subclasses if any error is to be considered fatal
(the usual case).
items.translation: 由于此类是运行时异常，如果任何错误都应被视为致命（通常是这种情况），则无需用户代码捕获它或其子类。

items.source: cause - the root cause (usually from using an underlying data access API such as JDBC)
items.translation: cause - 根本原因（通常来自使用底层数据访问 API，如 JDBC）
